signature: pageDocuments(after: String, cultureName: String, first: Int, keyword: String!, storeId: String!): PageDocumentConnection

args.name: after
args.description: Only return edges after the specified cursor.

args.name: cultureName
args.description: The language for which all localized category data will be returned

args.name: first
args.description: Specifies the maximum number of edges to return, starting after the cursor specified by 'after', or the first number of edges if 'after' is not specified.

args.name: keyword
args.description: The keyword parameter performs the full-text search

args.name: storeId
args.description: The store id where pages are searched
